arguments.title: Post-Incident Review: Misapplied Quarantine on WS-ENG-015
arguments.description: A quarantine action originally approved for a Cobalt Strike beacon on WS-ENG-015 (INC-2026-0555) was replayed during a separate phishing investigation (INC-2026-0612) without proper validation. Subsequent analysis shows no evidence of malware on the host. The action was based on an IP address (10.0.12.15) that was incorrectly associated with malicious activity. Investigation revealed the IP belongs to WS-IT-101, not WS-ENG-015. This indicates a critical gap in asset-to-IP mapping and replay logic. Recommend updating detection rules and playbook validation steps to prevent recurrence.
